alt: Pushing the same values onto a stack and adding them to a queue, then draining both: the stack gives them back in reverse order while the queue gives them back in the order they arrived.

steps.caption: Push 'a' onto the stack and add 'a' to the back of the queue. Stack: ['a']. Queue: ['a'].
Push 'b' onto the stack and add 'b' to the back of the queue. Stack: ['a', 'b']. Queue: ['a', 'b'].
Push 'c' onto the stack and add 'c' to the back of the queue. Stack: ['a', 'b', 'c']. Queue: ['a', 'b', 'c'].
Pop 'c' from the top of the stack; serve 'a' from the front of the queue. Stack has given back ['c']. Queue has given back ['a'].
Pop 'b' from the top of the stack; serve 'b' from the front of the queue. Stack has given back ['c', 'b']. Queue has given back ['a', 'b'].
Pop 'a' from the top of the stack; serve 'c' from the front of the queue. Stack has given back ['c', 'b', 'a']. Queue has given back ['a', 'b', 'c'].
Push 'x' onto the stack and add 'x' to the back of the queue. Stack: ['x']. Queue: ['x'].
Pop 'x' from the top of the stack; serve 'x' from the front of the queue. Stack has given back ['x']. Queue has given back ['x'].
